g.text: Wave-pinning · Stationary cue at fixed angle or fixed initial arc
P = M₁ / M₁(initial): direction and length show the activity vector. Grey rightward guide: initial P = 1.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start
font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Native full physical support = 3; prescribed peak = 0.1. Initial angular supports (left → right): 54.00°, 36.00°, 27.00°.
* Cue footprint intersects the original half-contrast core; every overlap is retained. Spring centres stay fixed in material coordinates.
Weak R < 0.1: magnitude-only circles, with no assigned heading. □ failed finite full-field tail check; △ unavailable full-field tail check.
One vector scale throughout: Δglyph = 0.24 P; equal x/y scales. Duration columns are categories. Both arms: 480 rows, 355 unique histories.
Target-relative colour uses wrapped angular distances; it is neither a binary success gate nor a minimum-duration estimate. Native clocks differ between models.
